subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should OpenClaw land the narrow fresh-session accepted-disconnect fix now, or require the broader reattach-first recovery design before this behavior changes?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and supported, but accepted-disconnect fallback determines whether users get a local rerun immediately or wait for the authoritative gateway run, which is a user-visible product tradeoff.

options.title: Land narrow fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case while preventing same-session transcript collision.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first
options.body: Require this PR to wait for the accepted gateway run before recooking locally, reducing duplicate side effects at the cost of a larger behavior change.

options.title: Pause for follow-up
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the broader accepted-disconnect policy in the linked product issue.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case while preventing same-session transcript collision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the CLI gateway dispatch path where this fallback decision lives.
